name: Realla
source:
Race: Female human
Hobby: Cycling
Job: Lawyer

Classy, dogmatic, obsessed. Realla is the lawyer hired to work for Chippy Company. Her glasses were given by lichanti in attempt to subdue her frightening peronality. however, it ended up changing her entire personality. Still, Realla insists on working togerther despite lichanti's objection.
